title: Spirits Advent Calendar – 24 Decorative Bottles
seo_description: A bar-themed Christmas gift you can give to anyone, without giving away alcohol.
descriptionHtml:
A bottle of liquor isn't right for everyone

You're buying a Christmas gift for someone who likes spirits, bars and whisky evenings – a colleague, a dad, a second cousin. A real bottle often feels too expensive, too big or inappropriate to give away at work, and you don't always know whether the person is driving over Christmas or has quit drinking. What you're looking for is something that shows you know what they like, without the gift being alcohol.

The bar feel without a drop of alcohol

This is a decorative box: 24 bottle-shaped pieces in whisky, cognac and vodka/gin style, without labels and without a drop of alcohol. The lid is printed with a Christmas tree made of liquor bottles and needs no wrapping, so it's ready to hand over right away. Since there is no alcohol in the box, it works just as well for the colleague, the driver or someone who doesn't drink.

What you get

  • A bar-themed Christmas gift you can give to anyone, without giving away alcohol
  • Suits the colleague, the driver or someone who doesn't drink – not a sensitive gift
  • 24 pieces last all the way to Christmas Eve
  • Ships as a regular parcel, with no alcohol rules or age limit to think about
  • A ready-made gift straight out of the box
  • 24 bottle-shaped decorative pieces in a red gift box
  • Designs: whisky, cognac, vodka and gin in a classic style, with blank labels without brands
  • The lid is printed with a Christmas tree of liquor bottles and the text Classic Base Liquor Advent Calendar 2025
  • Contains no alcohol and no liquid
  • Ready to give straight out of the box – no wrapping needed

Frequently asked questions

Does the advent calendar contain alcohol?
No. The 24 pieces represent classic liquor bottles (whisky, cognac, vodka and gin) as decoration – there is no drink and no liquid in the box.

What are the bottles made of?
The supplier doesn't say, so we don't want to guess at materials. What we know is that it's 24 bottle-shaped pieces without labels or brands.

Are the doors numbered 1–24?
The image we're working from shows a plain lid without visible numbers, so we can't promise numbered doors. You get 24 bottle-shaped pieces in the box, one for each day until Christmas Eve.

Can I give it to someone who doesn't drink, drives or is pregnant?
Yes. Since the calendar contains no alcohol, it suits anyone, whether or not the person drinks.

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
